Delivery & Shipping Policy

{/* Delivery Policy Section */}

Delivery Policy

{/* Sections 1–7 (Delivery Policy details) */} {/* 1. Processing Time */}

1. Processing Time

At Iibsy, we provide an online platform connecting buyers and vendors across Somaliland. Vendors on our platform are responsible for processing orders promptly. In general, orders are processed within 1–2 business days following payment confirmation. However, processing times may vary depending on the vendor’s internal workflow, stock availability, or during peak periods such as holidays and special sales events.
We recommend that customers communicate directly with the vendor for more precise processing timelines, especially for time-sensitive purchases.

{/* 2. Delivery Methods and Timeframes */}

2. Delivery Methods and Timeframes

Delivery methods and estimated delivery times are determined individually by each vendor in agreement with the client. Iibsy does not manage or coordinate the delivery process. Vendors may offer several delivery options, including:

  • In-person pickup at a specified location
  • Local courier delivery within Hargeisa
  • Private arrangement between vendor and client

The timeframe for delivery depends on the method selected, vendor availability, and customer location. Unexpected factors such as weather conditions, public holidays, or transportation disruptions may affect delivery schedules. Clients are encouraged to discuss delivery expectations directly with vendors before completing their purchase.

{/* 3. Delivery Costs */}

3. Delivery Costs

Delivery costs are negotiated directly between the vendor and the client. Iibsy does not set, control, or charge delivery fees. Depending on the vendor and delivery method chosen, costs may vary based on factors such as distance, product size, weight, and urgency of delivery.
It is important for customers to request a clear breakdown of any delivery charges from vendors before completing payment to avoid misunderstandings.

{/* 4. International Delivery */}

4. International Delivery

Iibsy primarily facilitates transactions and deliveries within Hargeisa, Somaliland. Vendors that offer international shipping do so independently. Clients interested in international delivery must coordinate all arrangements directly with the vendor, including agreements on shipping costs, timeframes, and any applicable import duties, taxes, and customs clearance requirements.

Iibsy does not assume responsibility for delays, additional fees, or issues arising from international shipments. Clients are urged to familiarize themselves with their country’s import laws and customs procedures before finalizing international orders.

{/* 5. Order Tracking */}

5. Order Tracking

Order tracking availability depends on the delivery method chosen and the vendor’s capabilities. Vendors who use recognized courier services may provide clients with tracking numbers and estimated delivery updates.
For deliveries arranged privately or through local means, clients are encouraged to maintain regular communication with the vendor to stay informed about the delivery status.

{/* 6. Delivery Restrictions */}

6. Delivery Restrictions

Certain products listed on Iibsy may have delivery limitations based on their size, weight, fragility, or legal restrictions. Additionally, some vendors may only offer delivery within specific areas of Hargeisa or require in-person pickup for particular items.
Clients should clarify delivery options with vendors prior to making a purchase to ensure there are no unforeseen issues.

{/* 7. Contact Us */}

7. Contact Us

Iibsy is committed to ensuring a positive marketplace experience for all users. If you have questions, concerns, or issues related to your order, delivery, or communication with a vendor, please reach out to our support team:

Email: delivery@iibsy.com
Phone: +252 (63) 673-0837

{/* Shipping Policy Section */}

Shipping Policy

General Shipping Information

Shipping policies may vary depending on the vendor you are purchasing from on Iibsy. While we facilitate vendor listings and customer interactions, we do not directly manage or operate shipping services. Shipping agreements, fees, timelines, and policies are set by each individual vendor.

Clients are advised to confirm shipping methods, estimated delivery times, and all shipping costs with the vendor before placing an order. Transparency at this stage ensures that both parties understand the shipment expectations.

Shipping Costs

Shipping costs are the responsibility of the client unless otherwise stated by the vendor. Fees depend on the type of product, delivery distance, shipping method, product weight, and urgency of the shipment. Some vendors may offer free shipping promotions or discounts under certain conditions, such as purchasing above a minimum amount.

Customs, Duties, and Taxes

For orders shipped internationally, clients are responsible for paying all applicable customs duties, import taxes, and handling fees. Vendors are not responsible for these charges, and any refusal to pay them may result in the order being returned, delayed, or forfeited. Clients should consult their local customs authority for guidance before purchasing internationally.

Lost or Damaged Shipments

In cases of lost or damaged shipments, clients should immediately contact the vendor and, if applicable, the shipping carrier. Vendors using reputable courier services often provide insurance and tracking services. Iibsy encourages all clients and vendors to maintain clear communication and resolve shipping issues promptly.

Estimated Delivery Dates

Estimated delivery dates are provided by the vendor and/or carrier and are not guaranteed. Unexpected events such as weather conditions, labor strikes, or transportation disruptions can impact delivery times. Please allow additional time during busy seasons such as Ramadan, Eid, or the end-of-year holidays.

Contact for Shipping Inquiries

For any questions specifically regarding shipping policies, estimated times, shipping charges, or customs processes, please contact the vendor directly. If further assistance is needed, you may also reach out to Iibsy’s customer support team.

Email: support@iibsy.com
Phone: +252 (63) 673-0837

Last updated: April 26, 2025
